text: 9.1 Part 1 Clarkson and Lyle, good morning. Oh, hi there. I saw your ad for a flat on Oak Street. Ah yes, number 29. It's just come on the market. It's nice and compact and very conveniently located. Only about 10 minutes from the tube. Sure, but I need to know how much the rent is. I'm on a tight budget. Oh, very affordable. Very affordable. So, the flat needs a bit of work. You know, a good clean and maybe a new coat of paint. OK, but everything depends on the rent. I understand. So, when would you like to see the flat? Erm, I can make two o'clock today, but can you tell me about the rent? And the name is... Paul, Paul Mitchell. Splendid, Mr Mitchell. I'm William Lyle. That's L-Y-double-L-E. And I shall see you at 29 Oak Street at 2 today. Yes, OK, but I do need to know how much the rent is. Oh.
